meaning: mooncake, a round pastry eaten during the Mid-Autumn Festival

example.hakka: 中秋節當暗晡,阿姆買月餅分大家食。
example.romanization: Chûng-chhiû-chiet tông-am-pû, a-mê mâi ngie̍t-piang pûn thai-kâ shi̍t.
example.english: On the evening of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Mom bought mooncakes for everyone to eat.

note: Families traditionally share mooncakes while gazing at the full moon on the 15th day of the eighth lunar month. The word 餅 (piang) is also used in Hakka for many other pastries and cakes.
